主要内容: On March 12, 2015, Medallion Financial Corp. appointed Marc Adelson as Chief Credit Officer and Chief Operating Officer, effective April 1, 2015. Mr. Adelson, age 54, joined the company in November 2014 as President of the company’s asset-based lending division, Medallion Business Credit. Prior to joining, he served as CEO of Capital Business Credit and Managing Director of GetzerHenrich & Associates. The company entered into an employment agreement with Mr. Adelson dated October 20, 2014, which will terminate on November 12, 2015. The agreement provides for an annual base salary of $312,500 and severance payments under certain conditions. It also includes a non-competition covenant in favor of the company.
